name: What is your real name?
author: daddybannk
queryHints:
One step is one row: old_name plus
the year gives you the next name.

Walk it ten times, 2017 to 2026,
or JOIN name_changes to itself ten
times and let the years do the work.

Write the years out as numbers.
c2.year = 2018, not c1.year + 1.

The last name is the only one of
the ten that is in residents.
caseHints:
Start at Allison Burgers in 2017.
That row is not the only one.

He changed his name EVERY year.
Each step is the very next year.

Three names on the chain were taken
by somebody else as well. Only the
next year's row is his.

The daft name is not his alone.
Twelve other residents answer to one.
